value.rationale: A complete exact antidictionary is a natural language invariant not determined by factor complexity alone. Two missing contexts per explicitly recursively determined bispecial prefix provide an all-length membership obstruction description for this canonical non-Arnoux–Rauzy ternary fixed point. The result is structurally motivated by recent Narayana special-factor research, not arbitrary parameter slicing.
